label: Matched four-account table under determination, by computation
meaning: Each account is one accountFrame over the four outcomes. The nature level is invariant, so by law 3 it explains exactly the outcomes outside the account's scope; by law 4 it selects only in the one-outcome scope. The exercise level's cell is the actual outcome, so it selects; with a second outcome in scope, law 6 gives Dstit of its cell and the nature level's failure to see to it.
